output_list.criticism: The vulnerability found is Payment Bug. The function PayWinner() is expected to transfer the totalBounty to the winner. However, the function only transfer the winnerPrice to the winner. The ownerTax is not transferred anywhere. This could lead to the following problems: 1) The owner will receive less than the total bounty. 2) The winner will receive more than the total bounty. The function should transfer the totalBounty to the winner.
